# Tax Executive

> > The professional journal of Tax Executives Institute providing expert analysis on tax policy, IRS enforcement, international taxation, and emerging compliance issues for corporate tax professionals.

Tax Executive is the official publication of Tax Executives Institute (TEI), serving as a comprehensive resource for tax professionals and executives. The site features in-depth articles, roundtable discussions, and professional profiles covering federal tax law, state tax compliance, international taxation, and emerging technologies in tax practice.

## Key Topics

- Tax Executives Institute (TEI)
- Internal Revenue Service (IRS)
- Internal Revenue Code (IRC)
- One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA)
- International taxation and GILTI
- Tax compliance and enforcement
- Research credits (Section 41)
- Sales tax and state conformity
- Tax refund litigation
- Tax insurance
- Clean energy tax policy
- AI in tax research
- Tax professionals and careers
- OECD Pillar Two
- Multinational taxation

## Core Organization

- [Tax Executive | The professional journal of Tax Executive Institute](https://www.taxexecutive.org): Homepage for Tax Executive Institute's professional journal covering tax policy and IRS matters
- [About TEI | Tax Executive](https://www.taxexecutive.org/about): Organization overview of Tax Executives Institute, membership, and global presence

## International and Multinational Taxation

- [OBBBA Modifications to US Taxation of International Income | Tax Executive](https://www.taxexecutive.org/obbba-modifications-to-us-taxation-of-international-income): Analysis of One Big Beautiful Bill Act changes to GILTI and multinational taxation
- [The Unconstitutionality of the Brazilian QDMTT | Tax Executive](https://www.taxexecutive.org/the-unconstitutionality-of-the-brazilian-qdmtt): Article examining Brazilian tax law, QDMTT minimum tax, and OECD Pillar Two compliance
- [How Does Conformity Impact State Revenues After the OBBBA? | Tax Executive](https://www.taxexecutive.org/how-does-conformity-impact-state-revenues-after-the-obbba): Article on state tax conformity impacts and IRC compliance following OBBBA changes

## Tax Compliance and Litigation

- [Considerations in Tax Refund Litigation | Tax Executive](https://www.taxexecutive.org/considerations-in-tax-refund-litigation): Article on tax refund litigation strategy, IRS procedures, and net operating loss claims
- [Are Tax Insurance Proceeds Taxable? | Tax Executive](https://www.taxexecutive.org/are-tax-insurance-proceeds-taxable): Article on tax insurance proceeds taxability under IRC Section 61 and IRS guidance
- [Sales Tax Traps for Disregarded Entities | Tax Executive](https://www.taxexecutive.org/sales-tax-traps-for-disregarded-entities): Article on sales tax compliance for disregarded entities across multiple states
- [Are Research Credit Interviews and Write-Ups Obsolete? | Tax Executive](https://www.taxexecutive.org/are-research-credit-interviews-and-write-ups-obsolete): Analysis of research credit documentation requirements and Section 41 compliance

## IRS Enforcement and Policy

- [How the IRS May Do More With Less | Tax Executive](https://www.taxexecutive.org/how-the-irs-may-do-more-with-less): Analysis of IRS funding, enforcement capabilities, and technology modernization efforts
- [How Is Tax Policy Shaping the Future of Clean Energy Investment? | Tax Executive](https://www.taxexecutive.org/how-is-tax-policy-shaping-the-future-of-clean-energy-investment): Analysis of tax policy's impact on clean energy investment and federal incentives

## Technology and Professional Development

- [TEI Roundtable No. 53: Using AI for Tax Law Research | Tax Executive](https://www.taxexecutive.org/tei-roundtable-no-53-using-ai-for-tax-law-research): Roundtable discussion on AI adoption for tax law research and workflow efficiency

## Executive Profiles

- [Emerging Leader: Riny Mathai | Tax Executive](https://www.taxexecutive.org/emerging-leader-riny-mathai): Profile of emerging tax executive Riny Mathai covering career and tax reform topics
- [Janelle Gabbianelli | Tax Executive](https://www.taxexecutive.org/janelle-gabbianelli): Executive profile of Janelle Gabbianelli covering tax career and professional development
